Set up Trail Guide (0.4.0 or later) in this project, which doesn't use it yet, then add these engineering rules.

From fabricahq/public-rules:
- The whole group techs/golang, including rules the library adds to it later
- The whole Testing group (practices/testing), including rules the library adds to it later
- The rule practices/testing/cover-boundary-cases, forked from version 1.0.0 as a local rule I can edit
- The rule techs/go/return-errors, forked from version 1.0.0 as a local rule I can edit

Run:
# From the root of your project

# Set up Trail Guide
curl -fsSL https://trailguide.fabricahq.com/install.sh | sh
trailguide project init

# Add your rules
trailguide project add source fabrica \
  --repository https://github.com/fabricahq/public-rules.git \
  --rules 'techs/golang/*' \
  --rules 'practices/testing/*'

trailguide project sync

trailguide project add rule practices/testing/cover-boundary-cases \
  --from fabrica@1.0.0 \
  --reason 'We maintain our own version of this rule.'

trailguide project add rule techs/go/return-errors \
  --from fabrica@1.0.0

trailguide project build

Then make sure AGENTS.md tells agents to read .trailguide/_managed/generated/RULES.md. The rules move to newer versions only when someone runs trailguide project update and confirms.
